## Objectives {#objectives}

By the end of this session you can:

- Parse any date-time format, including spreadsheet serials.
- Convert between UTC and local time, daylight saving included.
- Compute intervals across time zones.
- Join time-zone geography to population for a global calculation.

## What we cover {#coverage}

- Why clocks matter: event studies need them; survey timestamps lie in
  UTC; markets open across zones.
- lubridate in full; Excel serial dates; UTC vs local; daylight saving
  time; day-boundary drift.
- The world-clock exercise: at one UTC instant, compute local time
  everywhere, join population — what share of the world is likely
  awake?

**Verification habit.** Check against calendar facts you know
independently — sunrise, release weekdays — and investigate the
exceptions.
